source.source_text: Purpose: list enabled Mac-Operator capabilities, caller-visible scopes and macOS permission state; never expose credentials. Input: {}. Output: capability groups, enabled/disabled reason, granted host permissions, version. Contract: L0 read_only; scope mac.control.read; target broker; timeout 3000ms; cap 64KiB; network none; filesystem none; secret policy redact; approval trusted_read; idempotent yes; verification bounded result. Phase 1, status planned. Broker remains final authority.
